name: Robert
words: TSR 1, Bobby 0. First real competitive group ride today and I learned a lot. Such great people, and the competition was really fun. It’s fast paced, with lots of talking in the beginning, but once you take that right turn onto Dynamite it’s hammer down: find your group and lock in. Rode over from Central Phoenix, about a 14 mile add-on at the start, which was fine, but I wasn’t fully ready with my fuel. Need to figure that out for next time. Already excited to go back next week.
